title: Bridge
description: Manifest of one named bridge (bridges/<name>/bridge.json); the only place that knows its partner.

name.description: Bridge name; equals its directory name under bridges/.

direction.description: out: this package calls the partner; in: the partner feeds this package; both.

contract.description: Partner contract id or version the bridge speaks.

summary.description: One line on what the bridge connects.

entrypoints.description: Verb to script path relative to the bridge directory; verbs match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, at least one, checked by the dispatcher.

requires.description: Optional hints on how the partner is found.

cli.description: Partner command or script the bridge calls.

env.description: Environment variable that points at the partner root.

min_version.description: Lowest partner version the bridge supports.

extends.description: Extension slots of the plan schema this bridge supplies: slot name to a JSON Schema file inside the bridge (closed profile, references to its own $defs only).

orchestration.options.description: Schema of orchestration.options: the run options of the execution engine this bridge connects.
